Aero 14

Pros
  • Gorgeous OLED panel
  • Great battery
  • Quiet under load
Cons
  • Soldered RAM
  • Glossy screen

Pick it if you commute often, value a superb display, and don't plan to open the machine up.

Forge 16

Pros
  • Fastest of the three
  • Upgradeable RAM and SSD
  • Full port selection
Cons
  • Heavy
  • Fans are audible

Pick it if you render, model, or game — and you'll be near a power outlet most of the day.

Nimbus 13

Pros
  • Lightest
  • Best battery life
  • Lowest price
Cons
  • Dimmer screen
  • Small SSD

Pick it for classes, docs, and web work. Add an external drive if 256 GB feels tight.
